movement_source: row 'Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1)', column 31 Dec 24 column -> column 31 Dec 25 column
headline: CBA's APRA Level 2 (Group) CET1 ratio rose 10 bpts from 12.2% at 31 Dec 2024 (1H25) to 12.3% at 31 Dec 2025 (1H26), per the results book capital table (Dec 25 vs Dec 24 = 10 bpts) and corroborated in the presentation (12.2%→12.3%, +10bpts). The bank publishes only the half-on-half (Jun 25→Dec 25) capital walk, not a full-year walk. The only driver it quantifies in bpts for an event inside the Dec 24→Dec 25 window is adoption of the revised APS 117 framework (effective 1 Oct 2025), which reduced IRBB RWA by ~$10bn with a +24 bpts CET1 impact. The remaining +10 bpts net movement is not decomposed for this comparison; the half-on-half walk (Cash NPAT +107, 2H25 dividend -87, RWA -33, Other +9) is described in the narratives as context only.

drivers.narrative: Adoption of the revised APS 117 framework, effective 1 October 2025, reduced IRRBB RWA by ~$10 billion with a stated CET1 impact of +24 bpts (footnote 5). The presentation confirms the net impact of -$10bn RWA / +24bpts CET1. This is the only driver the bank quantifies in bpts for an event inside the Dec 24-Dec 25 window.

The bank names 'Capital generated from earnings' as a key driver of the CET1 change, but quantifies it only in the half-on-half (Jun 25-Dec 25) walk at +107 bpts Cash NPAT. No full-year (Dec 24-Dec 25) figure is disclosed, so its contribution to this comparison is unquantified.

The bank names 'The payment of the 2H25 dividend' as a key driver, quantified only in the half-on-half walk at -87 bpts (DRP neutralised). The 2025 final dividend included $643m on-market DRP purchase (-13 bpts). No full-year figure is disclosed for this comparison.

The bank names higher Credit, Traded Market and Operational Risk RWA partly offset by lower IRRBB RWA as a driver, quantified only in the half-on-half walk at -33 bpts RWA (Credit -34, Operational -9, Market -1, IRRBB +11). No full-year decomposition is disclosed.
The bank names 'Other regulatory adjustments and movement in reserves' as a driver, quantified only in the half-on-half walk at +9 bpts Other. No full-year figure is disclosed for this comparison.

disagreements.explanation: The task specifies the APRA Level 2 (Group) CET1 ratio. Level 1 and International CET1 are different measures; the International ratio moved in the opposite direction (-50 bpts) but is not the task's measure.

limitations: The bank publishes only the half-on-half (Jun 25-Dec 25) capital walk; no full-year (Dec 24-Dec 25) walk exists in either document. Per method, the half-on-half bars (Cash NPAT +107, 2H25 dividend -87, RWA -33, Other +9) are NOT restated as this comparison's contributions; they are described in narratives as context only.

Only the APS 117 IRBB +24 bpts impact is a stated bpts figure for an event inside the Dec 24-Dec 25 window. All other drivers are unquantified for this comparison, so a residual of -14 bpts (the unquantified remainder) is reported.

The +24 bpts APS 117 impact is a regulatory change; the bank's half-on-half walk shows IRBB +11 bpts as a sub-bar of RWA, but that is a different (half-on-half) framing and is not used as a contribution here.
Level 1 CET1 (12.1% Dec 24, 12.2% Dec 25) and International CET1 (18.8% Dec 24, 18.3% Dec 25) are different measures and are quoted as context only, not as the movement.
